comment: Interface for the static {@code CREATOR} field of {@link Bundleable} classes.

methods.name: T fromBundle(Bundle bundle)
methods.comment:
* Restores a {@link Bundleable} instance from a {@link Bundle} produced by {@link * Bundleable#toBundle()}. * *

It guarantees the compatibility of {@link Bundle} representations produced by different * versions of {@link Bundleable#toBundle()} by providing best default values for missing * fields. It throws an exception if any essential fields are missing.
